verdict.rationale: Figma's docs confirm teammates can share feedback with comments directly in shared multiplayer files, and webhooks fire when a collaborator comments on a file. A community user who works with comments notes they cannot drop images into them, which confirms comments exist in practice. However, nothing in the pack shows @-mentioning teammates or resolving comment threads, so only the core commenting part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of @mentions notifying teammates, evidence of resolving or closing comment threads, in-depth comment-workflow docs replacing email review.
